mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM mes_quality_task WHERE status = 'PENDING'
AND (inspector IS NULL OR inspector = '' OR inspector = #{inspector})
ORDER BY CASE WHEN urgent = true THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, create_time ASC

SELECT
FROM mes_quality_task WHERE status = 'INSPECTING' ORDER BY inspection_date DESC

SELECT
FROM mes_quality_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'INSPECTING') AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, create_time, NOW()) > #{timeoutMinutes} ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT
FROM mes_quality_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mes_quality_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status = 'PENDING'

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'INSPECTING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inspecting_tasks, SUM(quantity_checked) AS total_checked, SUM(quantity_qualified) AS total_qualified, SUM(quantity_defective) AS total_defective, CASE WHEN SUM(quantity_checked) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(quantity_qualified) * 100.0 / SUM(quantity_checked), 2) ELSE 0 END AS pass_rate FROM mes_quality_task WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
